notes.title: 1.095 upgrade note
notes.content: ~ Fix some light building errors and Npc combat bugs.

notes.title: Emergency！game version back to 1.094
notes.content: Due to some reason, the latest 1.095 was quite unstable leads to frequent system crash down. Now the 1.094 come back online. Please be patient, next time the 1.096 will be far more contents inside when it is back.

notes.title: 1.095 Update
notes.content:
·All the main levels’ enviorments optimized to run faster.
  ·Some animations of characters and NPCs adjusted in the battle mode.
  ·Other bugs fixed and the UI slightly adjusted.
  ·More high-resolution materials imported.

notes.title: 1.094 upgrade note
notes.content: ·All of the main level maps have the environments upgraded.It runs faster now.

·The UI of “Main Menu” and “Option Menu”adjusted.
·In the Battle mode,the solider’s shield attack optimized, and the Dancers’ can make duel weapon damage.
·Some in_combat animations adjusted.

 ·Now the impact and cut damage of some characters are distinguished.

notes.content:

notes.title: 1.09 Upgrade Notes
notes.content:
- Upgrade the game engine to Unreal Engine 5.1，it may bring some new bugs and the upgrades will continue, please be patient.
- Optimizations on the enviornments.
- All the characters’animations improved.

notes.title: Network Function
notes.content:
Warrior Beneath Heaven is now testing some extra online play methods. It may be not stable, and if you please don't mind the change on the interface as other functions still work. The server for this mode is not set up yet. 

Hopefully it may finally become part of this game one day! 

And please, this content is not include in the current product on sale, it is just extra and free. Thank you!

The game will continue to expand and bring more contents and optimizations.

notes.title: 1.07 Upgrade
notes.content:
1. New maps of Liu Wei Yang’s story added into the game.
2. Some regular optimazations.
3. Full direction avoid in battle mode now is available by double tapping direction keys.
4. In battle mode, the other keybindings is as usual.
5. Maps in battle mode is free for all.

notes.title: 1.061update
notes.content: ~ Optimization for the YuWen's Garden map, 30% faster than before.

notes.title: 1.05 upgrade notes
notes.content:
. New image for Shang GuanYan . In fact it is more close to the original design of her.
. Fix the powerattack of the two range-weapon characters.
. More adjusts to the Fights.
. Now, characters can be bounce_back and break the chain-attack when hitting a blocking enemy by chance determined by his weapon.
. 20% more health for the Characters which means the time for every battle increase.
. Some regular upgrades for the visual effects of the envionment.

notes.title: Version 1.04 Upgrade
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38794434/812ac80caa67a6dc08e8fd00875d6fc86f09fee2.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38794434/8f6c011995605f3f5f076e578cf7606664ac71a2.png[/img][/url]
Latest Version 1.04 Upgrade and fix notes:

1.Full support X-box controller now.
2.Some upgrades or changes for the fight-balance added with new combos.
3.New achievements system come online.

The game will continue bring more contents in the future. The next major upgrade will be released several months later. Some patchs will be released at any time without specific notifications.

notes.title: Version 1.03
notes.content:
Hi, friends. Thank you for your supports and waiting.

Updates in latest version 1.03:
1.MurongJue(bow) and YuelingZhi(throw dagger) now have power_attack skills instead of dash.
2.Some items can be broken during the fight. 
3.New materials and Special Effects added into the game.
